originalTitle: What Sent FTAI Aviation Stock Higher?

content:

FTAI Aviation (FTAI) stock climbed 17.3% on Thursday, October 29, 2026, even as the S&P 500 fell 0.3%. The company released third-quarter results the same day, reporting earnings per share that topped analyst estimates while revenue missed the mark. So what else did FTAI Aviation announce alongside its quarterly results?

FTAI Aviation Added A Big Buyback To Its Results

FTAI Aviation paired its quarterly figures with a $500 million accelerated share repurchase and doubled its total buyback authorization to $1.0 billion. Management said it will complete the repurchase on a short schedule by the end of 2026. The $500 million program accounts for about 2.5% of the company’s $20.1 billion market value at Thursday’s close. One news report that day tied the stock gain to strong earnings and the big buyback management promised.

Investors watch closely what a company does with its cash. Look at Tesla, which holds $45.4 billion in cash, yet has never made a free FSD ride offer for families that the Big Story estimates would cost about $340 million. Read Trefis Big Story : Musk’s Massive Marketing Miss Cost $10 Trillion .

The company delivered a mixed quarter. Earnings per share on the basis analysts compare with reached $1.43, beating the $1.41 estimate; reported earnings came to $1.45 per share. Revenue came in at $977.7 million, falling short of the $1,002.6 million analysts expected.

Management calls adjusted EBITDA, a profit measure before interest, taxes and depreciation, its key metric. For the third quarter, adjusted EBITDA was $348.3 million, up 15% from the second quarter. The company maintained its adjusted EBITDA guidance for 2026 and 2027, leaving the 2027 target at $2.3 billion. The 2026 outlook includes $1.05 billion of adjusted EBITDA from the Aerospace Products segment and $475 million from the Aviation Leasing segment. In its power business, FTAI Aviation said it now has over 100 Mod-1 units under contract for 2027 and 2028. Each Mod-1 is a modular power unit.

Similar Companies Rose Far Less Than FTAI Aviation

Companies on the Trefis peer list for FTAI Aviation also advanced, but by much less. Heico gained 5.0% and TransDigm 3.5%, with Willis Lease Finance and AAR also rising. XLI, the SPDR fund for industrial stocks, gained 1.0% while the S&P 500 fell. FTAI Aviation moved in the same direction as its peers, but its gain was more than three times the largest of theirs.

Where Does FTAI Aviation Stock Stand Now?

FTAI Aviation had no rise this large in any session over the prior 365 days. The closest comparable move was a 17.2% gain on April 30, 2026.

Even after the gain, the shares remain well below where they traded earlier in 2026. FTAI Aviation closed Thursday at $196.01, compared to a 52-week closing high of $310.04 on February 26, 2026. The stock reached its 52-week closing low of $152.80 on November 17, 2025. Over the six months from April 30, 2026, the stock lost 21.2% while the S&P 500 gained 7.7%. Over the past twelve months, FTAI Aviation returned 10.1%, against 13.3% for the S&P 500.

FTAI Aviation’s next report will cover the fourth quarter of 2026 and complete its results for the year. Adjusted EBITDA, the figure management calls its key metric, will be the one to watch in that report.

2026 年 10 月 29 日星期四，FTAI Aviation (FTAI) 股价上涨 17.3%，尽管标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.3%。该公司同一天发布了第三季度业绩，每股收益超出分析师预期，但营收未达到预期。那么，除了季度业绩之外，FTAI Aviation 还宣布了哪些内容呢？

FTAI Aviation 对其业绩进行了大规模回购

FTAI Aviation 将其季度数据与 5 亿美元的加速股票回购相结合，并将其回购授权总额增加了一倍，达到 10 亿美元。管理层表示，将在 2026 年底前短期内完成回购。截至周四收盘，这项 5 亿美元的计划约占该公司 201 亿美元市值的 2.5%。当天的一则新闻报道将股票上涨与强劲的盈利和管理层承诺的大规模回购联系起来。

投资者密切关注公司如何使用现金。以特斯拉为例，该公司持有 454 亿美元现金，但从未向家庭提供免费 FSD 乘车服务，据 Big Story 估计，这项服务的成本约为 3.4 亿美元。阅读 Trefis 大故事：马斯克的大规模营销失误导致损失 10 万亿美元。

该公司的季度业绩好坏参半。分析师比较的每股收益达到1.43美元，超出了1.41美元的预期；报告每股收益为 1.45 美元。收入为 9.777 亿美元，低于分析师预期的 10.026 亿美元。

管理层将调整后的 EBITDA（扣除利息、税项和折旧之前的利润衡量标准）称为关键指标。第三季度调整后 EBITDA 为 3.483 亿美元，比第二季度增长 15%。该公司维持 2026 年和 2027 年调整后 EBITDA 指引，2027 年目标为 23 亿美元。 2026 年的前景包括航空航天产品部门调整后的 EBITDA 为 10.5 亿美元，航空租赁部门调整后的 EBITDA 为 4.75 亿美元。在其电力业务方面，FTAI Aviation 表示，目前已签订 2027 年和 2028 年合同的 100 多台 Mod-1 机组。每台 Mod-1 都是模块化动力装置。

类似公司的涨幅远低于 FTAI Aviation

FTAI Aviation Trefis 同行名单上的公司也有所进步，但幅度要小得多。 Heico 上涨 5.0%，TransDigm 上涨 3.5%，Willis Lease Finance 和 AAR 也上涨。工业股 SPDR 基金 XLI 上涨 1.0%，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌。 FTAI Aviation 的发展方向与同行相同，但其涨幅是同行的三倍多。

FTAI 航空股票现在处于什么位置？

FTAI Aviation 在过去 365 天的任何交易日中都没有出现如此大的涨幅。最接近的可比走势是 2026 年 4 月 30 日上涨 17.2%。

即使上涨后，该股仍远低于 2026 年早些时候的交易价格。FTAI Aviation 周四收于 196.01 美元，而 2026 年 2 月 26 日收盘价为 310.04 美元，为 52 周高点。该股于 2025 年 11 月 17 日触及 152.80 美元的 52 周收盘低点。自 2026 年 4 月 30 日起的六个月内，该股下跌21.2%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨 7.7%。过去 12 个月，FTAI Aviation 的回报率为 10.1%，而标准普尔 500 指数的回报率为 13.3%。

FTAI Aviation 的下一份报告将涵盖 2026 年第四季度并完成全年业绩。调整后的 EBITDA（数字管理层称之为关键指标）将成为该报告中值得关注的指标。

FTAI Aviation 的再次失败会对您的计划产生什么影响？
